DashboardVerification.title: Profile verification
DashboardVerification.intro: Tenants see a verified profile — and choose it more often. The platform runs the check.
DashboardVerification.fixProfileName: Check the name on your profile
DashboardVerification.needsInfoLead: To continue, please fix the following:
DashboardVerification.queuedLead: Your application is queued for review. We'll let you know the decision.
DashboardVerification.collectionDisabledLead: Your application is saved. Review will start once we open document collection — until then, no level is granted to anyone.
DashboardVerification.resubmitHint: No need to fill everything in again — what you already entered is kept in the new application.
DashboardVerification.profileNameBody: It must match your document — otherwise the application will be rejected. Currently:
DashboardVerification.profileNameHint: The name is changed on your profile. We don't need a document number, and it isn't stored with the application.
DashboardVerification.legalNote: Kvaterka.by checks the documents submitted. This is not a legal review, not a title check, and not a guarantee — of identity or of a deal's safety.
DashboardVerification.collectionStopNotice: Document collection isn't open yet: the platform won't start collecting identity documents until we have a legal opinion. You can still leave an application — we'll let you know when review becomes available, and until then no level is granted to anyone.
DashboardVerification.noPropertiesHint: Create a listing first — the right to rent is verified for a specific property.
DashboardVerification.basisLegend: On what basis are you renting out this place
DashboardVerification.basisHint: The basis determines which document we'll ask for. The basis itself is your statement, not proof — a document will still be needed.
DashboardVerification.noteFieldLabel: Anything useful for us to know — optional
DashboardVerification.notePlaceholderProperty: For example: the property is registered under a maiden name.
DashboardVerification.notePlaceholderSelf: For example: the passport spells the name differently.
DashboardVerification.noteHint: Don't put a document number here — it isn't needed and doesn't belong in the application.
